name: Sandstone
notes: Red-rock colours. The whole app now uses a rust red accent on warm sand in light mode, and a lighter clay on dark baked brown in dark mode. The waveform and pads are rust, the stretch the grain pad can reach is ochre, the dashed line at your picked spot is desert teal, and the record button stays a true red. Smaller text is a warm brown instead of grey so it stays readable on the sand and on the pads. Every text colour measures 4.5 to 1 or better against what it sits on, and the shapes 3 to 1 or better. Nothing about the sound or the controls changed.
